name: Bad Bye
source:
The world collapsed. Cities emptied like broken veins. Those who remain trade in ghosts – and when the dead still have influence, you realize this dystopia runs on more than survival.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
世界崩塌了。城市像破裂的血管，流空了最後一點生氣。留下的人做起了幽靈的買賣。當死者依然能左右局勢，你才意識到，支撐著這個反烏托邦運轉的，遠不止求生的本能。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
